Subject: Onboarding paperwork + tax form for Redwood

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the warm welcome — excited to get Solivox set up as an approved vendor. Attached is our completed W-8BEN-E (we're a Cayman-registered entity that invoices from our US subsidiary for some projects). Our AP team is asking if Redwood needs an EIN for the US sub or if the foreign entity's GIIN/TIN is sufficient.

Quick context: we have two billing entities — Solivox Ltd (Cayman, primary contract) and Solivox US Inc (EIN 12-3456789) which handles USD invoicing on certain statements. For the work in scope (consulting + data ingestion project), we anticipate invoices from Solivox US Inc.

Can you confirm:
- Which tax doc you need on file to create a PO?
- If Redwood requires a notarized signatory or a bank letter to validate the US sub's EIN?

Attaching: Solivox_W8BEN-E_signed.pdf (attached)

Thanks,
Maria Sanchez
Head of Finance, Solivox Systems
attachments: [Solivox_W8BEN-E_signed.pdf (pdf, 210 KB)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Sanchez <maria@solivox.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding paperwork + tax form for Redwood

Maria — thanks for sending this over and for the clear breakdown. Quick note up front: because you indicated invoices will come from Solivox US Inc (EIN present), we will need either a completed W-9 for Solivox US Inc OR a W-8 form plus supporting crosswalk documentation that explains which legal entity will invoice.

Operationally: our procurement policy allows us to create a conditional PO for up to $25,000 while tax evidence is clarified (so vendors can start work). For anything > $25k we need fully executed tax paperwork and banking verification.

Could you please:
- Confirm which entity will issue the first invoice (Solivox US Inc OR Solivox Ltd)
- If Solivox US Inc, attach a completed W-9 for that entity (signed) or a bank letter showing the EIN on the account statement
- If invoices will come from Solivox Ltd, we will need the W-8BEN-E + a short memo from your tax/legal team that explains the billing flow and confirms withholding responsibilities

I've looped in Jordan from Procurement to coordinate PO timing. He can create a conditional PO to unblock the kickoff once we have the basic evidence.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Conditional_PO_instructions.pdf referenced]

Thanks Tessa. Apologies for not being explicit earlier — the first invoice will be issued by Solivox US Inc (EIN: 12-3456789). We've attached a bank verification letter for Solivox US Inc and can provide a signed W-9 by tomorrow morning (US time).

Attachments: Bank_Verification_Letter_Solivox.pdf (pdf, 85 KB)

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood issue a conditional PO for up to $40k (we have an immediate milestone that is ~$35k)? We understand the policy you shared but wanted to check if procurement can make an exception; we can accept standard hold-back until W-9 is on file.
2) If we submit the W-9 tomorrow, is that enough to trigger PO finalization or do you require notarization?

Thanks — will send the W-9 first thing.

Best,
Maria
attachments: [Bank_Verification_Letter_Solivox.pdf (pdf, 85 KB)]

Tessa / Grace — looping you both in with my recommendation. Given the bank verification and the vendor's willingness to deliver a signed W-9 tomorrow, procurement can approve a one-time exception to raise a conditional PO up to $40k with the following controls:

- PO will be issued as Conditional_PO_78321 with a 15% holdback until the signed W-9 is received and verified by Finance.
- Accounts Payable to route the first payment through escrow/hold for 10 business days to allow for verification if any discrepancies surface.
- If W-9 is not received by EOD tomorrow, PO will be reduced to $25k per standard policy.

Grace — are there any legal objections to the one-time increase with the holdback language? If you're comfortable, I'll issue the conditional PO and notify Maria that work can start.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
